thread:
devon_ops: Heads up — onboarding customer Helix into eu-west-11 next week. We need AWS quota bumps for P5 and G5 families, plus ENI/NAT/EIP increases. Also want IPv6 dual-stack enabled to reduce EIP pressure. Planning to use a reserved baseline + spot fallback pool.

alex_chang: Can you list target numbers? helps with the support case.

devon_ops: Target baseline (reserved): p5: 8 instances, g5: 12 instances, p4d: 2 instances. Spot fallback pool: additional g5 spot capacity ~20. ENIs: bump to 120, Elastic IPs: 60, NAT gateways per AZ: 6 (we're onboarding across 3 AZs). Request service-quotas for Launch Templates / ENI-per-instance as well.

maria_k: Cost note — reserved baseline will be covered under the onboarding contract, but spots for fallback will reduce unit cost during bursts. Need approval from finance for spot budget cap.

yves_infra: Also request an increase for DescribeNetworkInterfaces quota and possibly VPC IP address limit on the subnets. eu-west-11 new region may have lower default ENI ceilings. Ask support to set soft-limit to hard-limit for accelerators.

alex_chang: I'll open the AWS support case and ping our TAM. Drafted description below — feel free to copy/edit: 

```
Account: 123456789012
Region: eu-west-11
Request: Increase EC2 accelerator and networking quotas for production onboarding (Helix).
 - p5 family total instances: 8 (on-demand)
 - g5 family total instances: 32 (12 reserved + 20 spot fallback)
 - p4d family total instances: 2
 - ENI quota: 120
 - Elastic IPs: 60
 - NAT Gateways per AZ: 6
 - VPC IP address per subnet increase / enable IPv6 dual-stack
Rationale: Production ML inference workloads with high sustained GPU usage. Need dedicated baseline capacity and spot fallback to meet latency SLOs while controlling cost. Please advise on Dedicated Capacity/Placement options and expected lead time.
```

quota-bot: Created AWS support case #SR-0-1234-5678-9012. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=SR-0-1234-5678-9012

alex_chang: Also ran quick checks — current ENI quota: 40, Elastic IPs: 5, G5 family 0 (new region). Command used: 

```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-A4707D60 --region eu-west-11
aws ec2 describe-addresses --region eu-west-11
```

maria_k: Two asks: 1) can we prefer IPv6 for control plane egress to avoid EIP usage? 2) What's the fallback model if AWS can't grant full spot capacity before onboarding window?

yves_infra: For (1) yes — request ipv6: Enable dual-stack on the VPC and configure NAT64 for legacy IPv4-only endpoints. For (2) plan B: use cross-region fallback to eu-west-3 for non-latency-critical batch jobs, and scale down baseline until capacity becomes available. We should also explore reserved host or placement groups for the p5s if AWS suggests capacity reservations.

devon_ops: Thanks. @alex_chang please escalate to TAM if we don't hear back in 24h. @quota-bot drop the estimated ETA in case notes when AWS responds. I'll start subnet IP planning and add a /22 per AZ as contingency.

alex_chang: Will do. Pinging AWS TAM and support now. I'll update the thread with case updates and the escalation ticket.

quota-bot: AWS case updated by alex_chang, status: awaiting-support-response. Case ID SR-0-1234-5678-9012.

maria_k: FYI finance approved provisional spot budget up to $X/day for onboarding burst.

alex_chang: If we get partial quota (e.g., only g5 but not p5), we'll rework the launch template to use g5 as primary + autoscaler weights. I'll post the template diff when ready.

devon_ops: 👍 thanks everyone. Keeping this thread as single source for the onboarding quota work.
